card.name: Price and financial words in general text
card.fires_on: Words about money and cost, such as price, prices, financial and profits, in economics or food-budget passages. Also a few scattered words in unrelated web text, like Lincoln in a book title.

modes.label: Price and cost words
modes.description: The word price, prices, financial or profits, often right after 'the' and before a statement about effects.
modes.example: At Amazon’s website, the<< price>> changed to slightly more than $85

modes.label: Scattered book and history text
modes.description: A few strong hits fall on unrelated words in book titles or descriptions.
modes.example: Emancipation Proclamation:<< Lincoln>> and the Dawn of Liberty.
